summary: Locate the source of mzanǧro b-az=zineǧər before replacing 57/57
rationale: The supplied 57/57 verse describes forty demons and the length of their ears, with neither the quoted participle nor chains. The suggested 57/77 shares zineǧər but says to loosen chains from the speaker’s shoulders and does not contain mzanǧro b-az=zineǧər. The evidence establishes a citation problem but supplies no verified replacement, so no replacement is proposed.
